snippet.title: Crushed In Time (Teaser 2025)
snippet.description:
Announcing Crushed In Time from Draw Me A Pixel, the indie studio behind There Is No Game : Wrong Dimension.
Coming 2026 for PC, Mac, Nintendo Switch, iOS and Android.

✔️ WISHLIST NOW https://store.steampowered.com/app/3858650/Crushed_In_Time

❓ ABOUT THIS GAME
Embark on an adventure with Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson on this surprising and elastic point-and-click adventure. 
Grab, pull, and release to help them solve a bizarre investigation full of humor and meta-time travel!

👉 FOLLOW US
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/drawmeapixel.com
Twitter: https://twitter.com/DrawMeAPixel
Discord: https://discord.gg/zV6DF73eXa
